dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - PostgreSQL - Operations
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for PostgreSQL locks, blocking sessions, connection pressure, vacuum, bloat, storage, and optional replication metrics. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Operations and maintenance
pages.description: Capacity and maintenance signals for database stalls, storage growth, and replication readiness.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(db.connections), latest(db.maxconnections) FROM PostgresqlDatabaseSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), latest(blocked_query_id), latest(blocking_query_id) FROM PostgresBlockingSessions WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(total_wait_time_ms), count(*) FROM PostgresWaitEvents WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET wait_category, wait_event_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(table.bloatRatio), latest(table.bloatSizeInBytes), latest(table.deadRows) FROM PostgresqlTableSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name, schema_name, table_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(table.lastVacuum), latest(table.lastAutoVacuum), latest(table.lastAnalyze), latest(table.lastAutoAnalyze) FROM PostgresqlTableSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name, schema_name, table_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(table.totalSizeInBytes), latest(table.indexSizeInBytes), latest(table.dataSizeInBytes) FROM PostgresqlTableSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name, schema_name, table_name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(replication.lagSeconds), latest(replication.pendingBytes) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET replication.slotName TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Lock, blocking, wait-event, table-size, bloat, and query-monitoring widgets need the New Relic PostgreSQL integration plus optional table and statistics permissions documented in this runbook.
